SELECT p.id, p.owner_id, p.project_name, p.avatar_url, p.announcement, p.category, p.status, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_brief direct_brief WHERE direct_brief.project_id = p.id AND direct_brief.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND direct_brief.deleted = 0 ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_project_brief_ref ref WHERE ref.project_id = p.id AND ref.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND ref.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_brief direct_duplicate WHERE direct_duplicate.id = ref.brief_id AND direct_duplicate.project_id = p.id AND direct_duplicate.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND direct_duplicate.deleted = 0 ) ) AS brief_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_storyboard_script script WHERE script.project_id = p.id AND script.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND script.deleted = 0 ) AS script_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_video_segment video WHERE video.project_id = p.id AND video.tenant_id = p.tenant_id ) AS video_count, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM ai_project p WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted = 0
AND ( p.owner_id = #{ownerId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_project_collaborator collaborator WHERE collaborator.project_id = p.id AND collaborator.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND collaborator.user_id = #{ownerId} AND collaborator.status = 'active' AND collaborator.deleted = 0 ) )
LIMIT 1
